mapper.insert: INSERT INTO accommodations ( host_id, title, description, address, sido_code, gugun_code, latitude, longitude, accommodation_type, phone, email, website, status, check_in_time, check_out_time, amenities, avg_review_rating, review_count, recommend_score, min_room_price, max_room_price, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{hostId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{address}, #{sidoCode}, #{gugunCode}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{accommodationType}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{website}, #{status}, #{checkInTime}, #{checkOutTime}, #{amenities}, 0.0, 0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, h.business_name as host_business_name FROM accommodations a LEFT JOIN hosts h ON a.host_id = h.host_id WHERE a.accommodation_id = #{accommodationId}
SELECT a.*, h.business_name as host_business_name FROM accommodations a LEFT JOIN hosts h ON a.host_id = h.host_id WHERE a.host_id = #{hostId}

SELECT a.*, h.business_name as host_business_name FROM accommodations a LEFT JOIN hosts h ON a.host_id = h.host_id WHERE a.sido_code = #{sidoCode}
AND a.gugun_code = #{gugunCode}

SELECT a.*, h.business_name as host_business_name FROM accommodations a LEFT JOIN hosts h ON a.host_id = h.host_id WHERE (a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT a.*, h.business_name as host_business_name FROM accommodations a LEFT JOIN hosts h ON a.host_id = h.host_id WHERE a.accommodation_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT r.*, a.title as accommodation_title FROM rooms r JOIN accommodations a ON r.accommodation_id = a.accommodation_id WHERE r.accommodation_id = #{accommodationId}

SELECT r.*, a.title as accommodation_title, IFNULL(MIN(rav.available_count), 0) AS min_available_count FROM rooms r JOIN accommodations a ON r.accommodation_id = a.accommodation_id LEFT JOIN room_availability rav ON r.room_id = rav.room_id AND rav.date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} WHERE r.accommodation_id = #{accommodationId} GROUP BY r.room_id, r.name, r.description, r.price_per_night, r.capacity, r.room_type, r.bed_type, r.bathroom_count, r.amenities, r.status, r.created_at, r.updated_at, a.title ORDER BY r.price_per_night ASC, r.name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO accommodations ( host_id, title, description, address, sido_code, gugun_code, latitude, longitude, status, check_in_time, check_out_time, amenities, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{hostId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{address}, #{sidoCode}, #{gugunCode}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{status}, #{checkInTime}, #{checkOutTime}, #{amenities}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, h.business_name as host_business_name, sd.sido_name as sido_name, gg.gugun_name as gugun_name FROM accommodations a JOIN accommodations base ON a.sido_code = base.sido_code AND a.gugun_code = base.gugun_code LEFT JOIN hosts h ON a.host_id = h.host_id LEFT JOIN sido sd ON a.sido_code = sd.sido_code LEFT JOIN gugun gg ON a.gugun_code = gg.gugun_code WHERE base.accommodation_id = #{accommodationId} AND a.accommodation_id IS NOT NULL AND a.accommodation_id != #{accommodationId} AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE accommodations SET avg_review_rating = #{avgReviewRating, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, review_count = #{reviewCount, jdbcType=INTEGER}, recommend_score = #{recommendScore, jdbcType=DOUBLE}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE accommodation_id = #{accommodationId}
UPDATE accommodations SET min_room_price = #{minRoomPrice, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, max_room_price = #{maxRoomPrice, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE accommodation_id = #{accommodationId}
mapper.select: SELECT accommodation_type, COUNT(*) AS value FROM accommodations GROUP BY accommodation_type
